decoder.name: fidetype P11-01 causal ring-TCN CTC (personalised, no LM) + key-code writer
decoder.weights_licence: not released (CC BY-NC-SA data: research only)
training_data: emg2qwerty: generic model on 100 other users; personal fine-tuning on the train sessions of each of the 8 users (never the track val or test session)
decoder.training_regime: personalised (fine-tuned on earlier sessions of the same user)

policy.name: drop-in guard (built-in CTC beam, no LM, key-code space)
policy.description: fidetype.trust.calibrate on 1224 track-val prompts of the same 8 users, alpha 0.05, delta 0.1, decision window = prompt + 0.20 s

basis.shuffled: input level: the test session EMG features time-shuffled (seeded per session), then the same decoder, writer and policy
basis.zeros: input level: zero EMG (every band at log(1e-6)), then the same decoder, writer and policy

guarantee.scope: marginal over test prompts pooled over the 8 users; exchangeable val / test sessions; the bound covers the pool (all users together), not each user: one user can be worse (trust guarantee section 4: https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/docs/trust-guarantee.md#4-what-is-not-guaranteed)

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

safe_wpm_v02.definition_status: adopted 2026-11-22: the headline metric (prefix credit + the aac-gaze-v1 reading cost); safe-wpm/0.1 stays selectable with metric_version='0.1' for old numbers

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit
correction_rule.prefix: a wrong prefix of k words costs the penalty of the first k words of the truth

reading_cost.formula: 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word * k per commit (right or wrong); prefix commits with fewer than 1 word(s) count as no commit
reading_cost.note: the adopted safe-wpm/0.2 reading cost (2026-11-22) is 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word per commit, minimum prefix 1 word; other values give a sensitivity variant

safe_wpm_v02.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

notes: RESEARCH ONLY (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data). Track-conformant: the decoder sees only the EMG (no key times). Causal, no lookahead; the decision waits 0.20 s after the prompt end. P11-09.
Key track: one character per key, so CER = key error rate.
RESEARCH ONLY: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data. Results and weights are non-commercial.

2026-11-25: the scope line now says that the bound covers the pool of all users, not each user (trust guarantee section 4). Basis: the pooled-guard check (commit 74a21f8; https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/experiments/2026-11-25-pooled-guard-check/results.md). No number changed.
